content.title: Call of the Wild Rift - App Store
content.text: Since its debut in 2009 on Windows and macOS, League of Legends (LoL) has become one of the world’s most popular games with millions of players across the globe. It’s also one of the biggest esports titles, with its 2019 World Championship reaching more than 100 million viewersNow, League of Legends: Wild Rift is ready to deliver that familiar LoL experience on mobile, reworked and refined for gaming on the go. It’s all here: Wild Rift brings you the core League of Legends experience with thoughtful tweaks to feel right at home on your mobile device. The classic gameplay is all here: first, players pick their own champions with unique abilities such as swordsman Yasuo, assassin Master Yi or sorceress Ahri to take part in 5v5 battles. The battlefield, set in the fantasy world of Runeterra, is divided into three main lanes, with jungle areas in between. You can fight minions and the opposing team’s champions, demolish their turrets on the lanes or hunt neutral monsters in the jungle to earn various bonuses. As champions level up and earn gold through fighting, they’ll unlock more powerful abilities and be able to purchase stronger equipment, making every encounter increasingly deadly and climactic. The goal of the match is to destroy the enemy Nexus in their home base, a feat that requires excellent teamwork, nimble reflexes and sharp thinking.While that may sound daunting, Wild Rift offers a handy series of tutorial missions that will ease you in. Finish those missions, and you’ll also earn enough valuable Blue Motes to buy a new champion. In addition, you’ll get some free champions as your player levels go up. You’re entirely new to League of Legends? Wild Rift comes with a set of great tutorials to teach you the most important basics, such as controls and rules. Thanks to all of that, you can practice and find the role that suits you best, such as a fighter that likes to get up close, a flexible jungler that roams the map or a mage that can deal massive damage from afar and disrupt enemy strategy.Wild Rift doesn’t merely bring the LoL gameplay to mobile devices, however. The new game has been rebuilt from the ground up to deliver an optimised experience for handheld gaming.The map is now mirrored to give everyone the same perspective, while controls can be freely customised to fit the position of your fingers. Auto-targeting options help make controls easier, while veteran players can still opt for manual targeting. Some champions’ abilities, such as Miss Fortune’s Double Up, have also been tweaked to suit the new controls. For faster communication, Wild Rift encourages its players to use visual pings and (optional) voice chat instead of the classic text chat. In tight situations and fights against the enemy, it will always come down to how great you’re able to work as a team. A match can be finished much faster now, often within 15 to 20 minutes, thanks to fewer turrets and the removal of turret shields. For players that love to add a touch of flair, there’s a new customisation system, so you can add different poses and recall effects for your champions, as well as a custom rift style.Wild Rift already has plenty of champions to choose from, and the roster will keep growing over time. As can be expected with LoL, you’ll also get to participate in lots of exciting events, as well as reap rewards from a season pass system when you hit certain milestones. The diverse set of champions that fit any play style is a big part of what gives Wild Rift such incredible depth and strategy. In the crowded arena of multiplayer games on mobile, Wild Rift is among the mightiest contenders, with deep gameplay, a strong player community and breathtaking production quality. Veteran LoL players will easily find themselves at home, while newcomers will discover the world of Runeterra in the most accessible way ever.
